visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A calico cat with distinct orange and black patches sits on a white tiled floor with its back squarely to the viewer. A human hand enters from the bottom right corner, hovering near the cat's tail in anticipation. Black bold text with a white border is displayed clearly at the bottom of the frame against the neutral background. (2) The person's hand reaches out and gently wraps its fingers around the base of the cat's tail while the feline remains remarkably still. The cat's body is oriented away from the camera, showing no immediate reaction. The background shows a clean, brightly lit domestic living space with minimal clutter on the light-colored floor. (3) The hand shifts its grip further down the tail towards the tip, squeezing gently with a playful motion. The cat's tail exhibits some tension, and the cat's back muscles twitch slightly under its fur in response to the tactile stimulation. More Traditional Chinese subtitles appear on the screen to narrate the action. (4) The hand holds the very end of the tail firmly for a moment. The cat does not turn around to face the owner, but its ears flick slightly towards the source of the touch. The lighting is even and bright studio-like quality, highlighting the soft texture of the cat's fur and the smooth, reflective floor. (5) The scene cuts to a side profile of the cat lying down on its chest, resting its chin and upper body on a large, tan, bone-shaped plush toy. The cat stares forward with a neutral, slightly bored expression. In the background, a brown leather sofa and a modern coffee table with black metal legs are visible.
